quest.00FA2658B4F9B420.quest_desc: Purferfish has been given a few other recipes to make it more accesible than regular fishing, check them out!
quest.01B5A1E674D7AF1E.quest_desc: Having trouble getting a Trident from Ocean Monuments or Drowned? Well now you can craft an &bInert Trident&r and infuse it to a normal Trident!

quest.02D23779EC7C72E4.title: &9Soul-Touched Deepshelf

quest.04787EFC50B743C2.title: &dDraconic Endshelf

quest.06193F4FCFE796C6.title: &o&9Soul-Touched Sculkshelf
quest.091E5C879772310D.quest_desc: Have you ever gotten an &bUnbreaking X&r, &bThorns V&r, and &4Curse of Binding&r netherite chestplate that was impossible to break because you can't take it off? &oNo? Just me?&r

quest.0DB2F08E593B2B93.quest_desc: Now we'll need a &dBudding Amethyst&r, luckily Apothic Enchanting gives us an infusion recipe!

quest.0DB2F08E593B2B93.title: &5Budding Amethyst
quest.0E96A0AEBFCAD34D.quest_desc: The &5Geode-Encased Bookcase of Stability&r provides &6Quantic Stability&r which means that you're pretty much &oguaranteed&r to get high level enchants!
quest.0E96A0AEBFCAD34D.title: &5Geode-Encased Bookcase of Stability
quest.162694C7F0BA16A9.quest_desc: &9Dormant Deepshelves&r are pretty much useless on their own, so you'll need to "awaken" them (aka infuse them)

quest.162694C7F0BA16A9.title: &9Dormant Deepshelf
quest.170499F17B55FDCD.quest_desc: &bSpirit Attuned Crystals&r from Occultism give &a+3 Eterna&r up to a max of &a45 Eterna&r.
quest.170499F17B55FDCD.quest_subtitle: Crystals really do give you powers...
quest.170499F17B55FDCD.title: &aMore Eterna!
quest.1B7D92A34E8743E2.quest_desc: &oWait, that's not how the saying goes...&r

quest.1C2725141CCA39D7.quest_desc: The &bTome of Superior Scrapping&r extracts all enchants, but &odestroys&r the item.

quest.1C2725141CCA39D7.title: Tome of Superior Scrapping
quest.1EE93E4C80945A97.quest_desc: Now that you have all the shelves, its time ot make the best enchanting setup.
It'll have &95x Soul-Touched Sculkshelf&r, &95x Echoing Sculkshelf&r, &d1x Draconic Endshelf&r, &61x Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures&r, and &51x Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability&r.
&e&oRemember that this setup will also includes curses!&r
&bOptional:&r You can filter out any enchantment by slotting their book in a

quest.254B7CA3BF8C296B.quest_desc: The &6Beeshelf&r gives a &a-30 Eterna&r debuff, but in return gives &c+100% Quanta&r!

quest.2818BDCD7EDDDDDB.quest_desc: The &bHeart-Forged Seashelf&r gives lots of &aEterna&r and &5Arcana&r and can be used in other enchanting setups.
Feel free to experiment with other setups if you'd like!
quest.2818BDCD7EDDDDDB.title: &bHeart-Forged Seashelf
quest.29ABE9033578C179.quest_desc: You can craft the &9Echoing Sculkshelf&r only after you defeat the hardest vanilla Minecraft boss, the &9Warden&r!
You'll need to upgrade all 5 of your &9Echoing Deepshelves&r into this &9Sculkshelf&r variant.
The &9Sculkshelf&r variant also provides &3+1 Enchanting Clues&r as well as having a max &aEterna&r of &a80&r!
quest.29ABE9033578C179.title: &o&9Echoing Sculkshelf
quest.2CEED480C5F876D6.quest_desc: This is a new item, meant to be an extra step for a better setup. Or maybe some magical stuff hides behind it
quest.2FE7E18D413274B6.quest_desc: Now you're on to the highest tier of shelves, &dEndshelves&r. However these shelves need a spcial ingredient, &dInfused Dragon's Breath&r.
You can infuse the normal Dragon's Breath using &95x Echoing Sculkshelf&r, &a5x Melonshelf&r, &25x Normal Bookshelf&r, &92x Soul-Touched Sculkshelf&r, and &51x Geode-Encased Bookcase of Stability&r.
quest.2FE7E18D413274B6.quest_subtitle: You need to see a dentist
quest.2FE7E18D413274B6.title: &dInfused Dragon's Breath
quest.3292668B69E6A25D.quest_desc: &dEndshelves&r are the top tier of shelves and provide a max of &a90 Eterna&r, perfect for everyday enchanting.
You can also use them to craft &dDraconic Endshelves&r.
quest.3292668B69E6A25D.title: &dEndshelf
quest.35052C9371FE6843.quest_desc: The &4Blazing Hellshelf&r is not usually used in normal enchanting since it has a &c-1 Enchanting Clue debuff&r. It's normally used in infusion setups.
We will not be using it in this questline, but you are free to experiment with other setups using this shelf!
quest.35052C9371FE6843.title: &6Blazing Hellshelf
quest.35570C818FB1333F.quest_desc: To get the &bLibrary of Alexandria&r you'll need to infuse it rather than crafting it. It can hold more enchants than the Enchantment Library.
You'll need &96x Echoing Sculkshelf&r, &a3x Melonshelf&r, &d2x Draconic Endshelf&r, and &b2x Infused Seashelf&r and be at least &blevel 100&r.
quest.3A651E06C7FBF861.quest_desc: &cQuanta&r is the main stat of &4Hellshelves,&r you'll need to craft &412x Hellshelves&r.
quest.3A651E06C7FBF861.title: &4Hellshelves
quest.3DF1A6F2F4DE5EA3.quest_desc: I'm pretty sure crafting these are much easier but...
If you want to infuse them you'll need &25x Normal Bookshelves&r and &61x Blazing Hellshelf&r.
quest.413527F17F167F3F.quest_desc: You can convert a &bBottle of Honey&r into &bXP Bottles&r!

8x Bottles: &95x Echoing Sculkshelf&r and &91x Soul-Touched Sculkshelf&r
32x Bottles: &95x Echoing Sculkshelf&r, &93x Soul-Touched Sculkshelf&r, and &d1x Draconic Endshelf&r
quest.43A8D8D6947220F4.quest_desc: The &dPearlescent Endshelf&r provides &a+10 Eterna&r to a max of &a90&r, &c+7.5% Quanta&r and &5+7.5% Arcana&r.
This is the better version of the &dEndshelf&r and can be used for everyday enchanting if you want!
quest.43A8D8D6947220F4.title: &dPearlescent Endshelf
quest.446EB701F7FBEBD0.quest_desc: Allows to select a specific arcane, quanta and eterna in slicer bar
quest.484B493059391887.quest_desc: The &bTome of Extraction&r will extract all enchants &oand&r keep your item.
You'll need &94x Soul-Touched Sculkshelf&r and &d1x Draconic Endshelf&r for this infusion setup and be at least &blevel 60&r.
quest.484B493059391887.title: Tome of Extraction
quest.4DCBA85D24DFDC5C.quest_desc: Need some extra &cQuanta?&r Put some &bskulls&r around to increase it!
&bNormal skulls&r give &c+5% Quanta&r while &0Wither skulls&r gives &c+10% Quanta&r.
quest.4DCBA85D24DFDC5C.title: &cMore Quanta!
quest.4EC0AED4959AB074.quest_desc: &5Arcana&r is the main stat of &bSeashelves,&r you'll need to craft &b15x Seashelves&r and then place them down.
quest.4EC0AED4959AB074.title: &bSeashelves
quest.514B2D0B6F8E1E04.quest_desc: Now take your extra &bSeashelf&r and infuse it. You should see an infusion option for &b3 EXP&r.
Now replace one of the uninfused &bSeashelf&r with your &bInfused Seashelf&r.
Repeat this until all 15 &bSeashelf&r are &bInfused Seashelf&r.
quest.514B2D0B6F8E1E04.title: &bInfused Seashelves
quest.51970F01EFF7AA39.quest_desc: Ever want more &bEcho Shards&r? Now you can duplicate them &b4x&r!
You'll need &95x Echoing Sculkshelf&r and &d1x Draconic Endshelf&r.
quest.51B99D1198D30855.quest_desc: Now that you have all your &bInfused Seashelves&r, you'll need to craft &b12x Crystalline Seashelf&r so you can make the next shelf!
quest.51B99D1198D30855.title: &bCrystalline Seashelf
quest.51EF51862695FB96.quest_desc: The &3Hellshelf of Masterful Sight&r is even better and gives you the ability to preview &b2 enchants&r!
quest.51EF51862695FB96.title: &3Enchanting Clues 2.0
quest.55B5FB4DF51A59B7.quest_desc: Want to filter out annoying/useless enchants like &bKnockback&r, &bRebounding,&r or &4Curses&r?
The &bSeashelf of Aquatic Filtration&r allows you to slot up to &b6 single-enchantment books&r to add them to your enchantment blacklist.
&aRemember:&r There can only be &o&61 enchantment&r per book for it to work!
quest.55B5FB4DF51A59B7.title: &bEnchantment Filtering
quest.5CF3600A45D365F5.quest_desc: If you went the &bSeashelf&r route, place down &b12x Crystalline Seashelves&r and infuse them
If you went the &4Hellshelf&r route, place down &412x Glowing Hellshelves&r and infuse them.
quest.5CF3600A45D365F5.title: &9Deepshelf
quest.617BBE7ACB125208.quest_desc: &bApothic Enchanting&r overhauls the entire enchanting system, allowing you to get exactly what you want. It also introduces a mechanic called &bInfusion&r which you can use to make more powerful items!
&aEterna&r is the main enchanting stat and increases the maximum enchanting level.
&cQuanta&r controls how low or high the enchantment level gets.
&5Arcana&r controls how often rare enchantments show up.
You can always click the &b'?' in the top right of the enchantment screen&r to see all possible enchants and rarities!
quest.61EE5D51D5CB807B.quest_desc: The Stoneshelf gives a &a-3 Eterna&r and &5-7.5% Arcana&r debuff.
quest.69A81468F8BB8871.quest_desc: &bApothic Enchanting&r adds special tomes that fit any given armor, weapon, or tool category.
This allows you to enchant &o"risk-free"&r by allowing you to throw away (or split) any enchants that you do not want.
quest.69A81468F8BB8871.title: Enchantable Tomes
quest.69D74428BB9CC623.quest_desc: Ever want &bMending,&r &bSwift Sneak&r, or &bFrost Walker&r? The &6Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures&r enables all treasure enchants like them!
&oBut beware&r, this means &4curses&r will also be on that list!
See the next page for a list of all valid enchants!
Here's a list of all treasure enchants in Little Bit Large!
quest.69D74428BB9CC623.title: &6Getting Treasure Enchants
quest.6C10C757F924E1DD.quest_desc: The &bEnchantment Library&r allows you to store enchantment books.

The &6Level Capacity&r refers to the highest level of enchantment it can store, in this case it's &blevel XVI (16)&r. &oHowever,&r this doesn't matter in &bLittle Bit Large&r because the enchantment levels do not go that high.
You can can only take out the &bhighest level&r enchant that you put in. For example if you put a &bSharpness V&r book in, you &ocan't&r take out a Sharpness VI book, only level V and below
You can &bShift-Click&r to take out the highest level of enchantment.
quest.6D00948588B44926.quest_desc: Vanilla &bcandles&r give &5+1.25% Arcana&r per candle while Occultism &blarge candles&r give &5+4% Arcana&r per candle.
quest.6D00948588B44926.quest_subtitle: What is pink sand even supposed to smell like?
quest.6D00948588B44926.title: &5More Arcana!
quest.6D4FB5CE5BA905D2.quest_desc: Just like &bSeashelves&r, &9Echoing Deepshelves&r provide higher &aEterna&r and &5Arcana&r!
You'll need to craft &95x Echoing Deepshelves&r.
quest.6D4FB5CE5BA905D2.title: &9Echoing Deepshelf
quest.6D8AF09174D7779D.quest_desc: Now you're going to make &412x Infused Hellshelves&r.
Place &215x Normal Bookshelves&r and &45x Hellshelves&r down so you can infuse the rest of the &4Hellshelves.&r
You can replace the uninfused shelves with infused ones as you go.
quest.6D8AF09174D7779D.title: &4Infused Hellshelf
quest.6D93652BDFA881F0.quest_desc: Now that you've infused all your shelves into &412x Infused Hellshelves&r, craft them all into &4Glowing Hellshelves&r, you should have 12 in the end.
quest.6D93652BDFA881F0.title: &4Glowing Hellshelf

quest.70B9826E828AF96C.quest_subtitle: These amazing quests were made for &4Catalyst Studios&r
quest.70B9826E828AF96C.title: &l&4Catalyst Studios Quests
quest.76C1268FC04633AD.quest_desc: Little Bit Large has a few ways to disenchant items.
The cheapest way to disenchant is to drop an &bAnvil&r on your item and some &bbooks&r onto &bobsidian&r like in the image below.
The &bDis-Enchanting Table&r is another easy choice.
&bApothic Enchanting&r also has &btomes&r that will extract enchants.
quest.76C1268FC04633AD.title: Disenchanting
quest.774EF435A320B705.quest_desc: &bApothic Attributes&r adds potion charms that are very convient and break pretty easily, but you can &binfuse&r them to make them &bUnbreakable.&r
You'll need &d5x Draconic Endshelf&r, &92x Echoing Deepshelf&r, &a1x Melonshelf&r, and &d1x Endshelf&r.
